senses.en: a main road or public street through a place

ex.en: The parade blocked the city's busiest thoroughfare for hours.
ex.zh: 遊行隊伍把城裡最繁忙的大街封住了好幾個小時。

root.note: 可以穿行而過的路 → 大街

mn: 標誌上 No Thoroughfare 意思是「此路不通」。

senses.en: the state of being controlled or strongly influenced by someone or something
a slave or servant

ex.en: The audience sat in thrall as the magician performed his final trick.
ex.zh: 魔術師表演最後一個戲法時，觀眾全都看得入迷。

mn: in thrall to 意為「受…支配、被…迷住」；enthrall（使著迷）由此而來。

senses.en: the condition of soil for growing crops
the cultivation of land

ex.en: Adding compost will improve the tilth of heavy clay soil.
ex.zh: 加入堆肥能改善黏重土壤的耕性。

root.note: 耕種的狀態 → 耕作狀況

senses.en: the particular quality of a sound or voice that makes it distinct

ex.en: A violin and a flute playing the same note differ in timbre.
ex.zh: 小提琴和長笛演奏同一個音時，音色不同。

mn: 發音也可讀作 [ˋtæmbɚ]；別和 timber（木材）搞混。

senses.en: showing or feeling nervousness and lack of confidence

ex.en: The timorous puppy hid under the bed whenever guests arrived.
ex.zh: 每當有客人來，那隻膽小的小狗就躲到床底下。

root.note: 充滿害怕的 → 膽小的

senses.en: a medicine made by dissolving a drug in alcohol
a slight trace or tint
senses.zh: 些微的痕跡；淡淡的色調

ex.en: The nurse applied a tincture of iodine to the cut.
ex.zh: 護士在傷口上塗了碘酒。

root.note: 染上的顏色 → 淡淡色調；泡製的藥液 → 酊劑

senses.en: a slight trace of a color, feeling, or quality
to color slightly or add a trace of a feeling

ex.en: There was a tinge of sadness in her voice as she said goodbye.
ex.zh: 她道別時，聲音裡帶著一絲哀傷。

root.note: 染上一點點 → 一絲色調

senses.en: slightly drunk

ex.en: After two glasses of wine, my uncle got a little tipsy and started singing.
ex.zh: 兩杯酒下肚，我叔叔有點醉，開始唱起歌來。

senses.en: a long, angry speech of criticism

ex.en: The coach launched into a tirade about the referee's decisions.
ex.zh: 教練對裁判的判決發表了一長串激烈的抨擊。

senses.en: working hard without seeming to get tired
senses.zh: 不知疲倦的；孜孜不倦的

ex.en: The nurse was praised for her tireless care of patients during the pandemic.
ex.zh: 這位護理師因疫情期間不眠不休地照顧病患而受到表揚。

senses.en: causing annoyance or boredom

ex.en: Filling out the same form again and again is tiresome.
ex.zh: 一次又一次填寫同樣的表格真令人厭煩。

senses.en: of enormous size, strength, or power

ex.en: The two companies fought a titanic battle for control of the market.
ex.zh: 兩家公司為了掌控市場展開一場巨大的激戰。

parts.m: 泰坦（希臘神話中的巨人族）

root.note: 像泰坦巨神一樣的 → 巨大的

mn: 鐵達尼號（Titanic）就是取「巨大」之意。

senses.en: involving hard, tiring work

ex.en: The climb up the steep trail was long and toilsome.
ex.zh: 爬上那條陡峭的山路漫長又辛苦。

root.note: 充滿辛勞的 → 辛苦的

senses.en: able to be endured
fairly good; acceptable

ex.en: The pain was tolerable, so she decided not to take medicine.
ex.zh: 疼痛還能忍受，所以她決定不吃藥。

root.note: 能夠忍受的

senses.en: willingness to accept opinions or behavior different from one's own
the ability to endure something, such as a drug or hardship

ex.en: The school promotes tolerance and respect for all cultures.
ex.zh: 這所學校提倡對所有文化的包容與尊重。

root.note: 能忍受不同 → 寬容

senses.en: willing to accept views or behavior different from one's own
able to endure specific conditions

ex.en: Cactus plants are tolerant of heat and drought.
ex.zh: 仙人掌很耐熱又耐旱。

root.note: 能忍受的 → 寬容的

senses.en: to allow something that one dislikes or disagrees with
to endure without harm

ex.en: The teacher will not tolerate cheating of any kind.
ex.zh: 老師絕不容忍任何形式的作弊。

root.note: 忍受 → 容忍

senses.en: the practice of allowing opinions or religions different from the official one
senses.zh: （宗教、意見上的）寬容政策；容忍

ex.en: The treaty granted religious toleration to minority groups.
ex.zh: 這項條約給予少數群體宗教寬容。

root.note: 容忍的做法 → 寬容政策

senses.en: the physical features of an area of land, such as hills and rivers
the study or mapping of such features

ex.en: The rugged topography made building a railway extremely difficult.
ex.zh: 崎嶇的地形讓鐵路興建極為困難。

root.note: 描繪一個地方 → 地形

senses.en: a state of physical or mental inactivity; sluggishness
a temporary state of lowered body activity in animals

ex.en: After the huge holiday meal, the whole family sank into torpor.
ex.zh: 吃完豐盛的節日大餐後，全家人都懶洋洋地動不了。

root.note: 麻木的狀態 → 遲鈍

senses.en: very hot and dry
full of passion; intense

ex.en: The travelers rested in the shade during the torrid afternoon.
ex.zh: 旅人們在酷熱的午後躲在陰涼處休息。

root.note: 被烤乾的 → 酷熱的

senses.en: (law) relating to a wrongful act that causes harm and can lead to a civil lawsuit

ex.en: The lawyer argued that the company's negligence was tortious.
ex.zh: 律師主張公司的疏失構成侵權。

parts.m: twist, wrong 扭曲、不法行為

root.note: 扭曲正道的不法行為 → 侵權的

mn: tortious（侵權的）、tortuous（彎曲的）、torturous（折磨人的）三個字常被混淆。

senses.en: full of twists and turns
excessively long and complicated
senses.zh: 冗長複雜的；拐彎抹角的

ex.en: The bus crawled up the tortuous mountain road.
ex.zh: 公車沿著蜿蜒的山路慢慢爬升。

root.note: 扭來扭去的 → 曲折的

mn: tortuous 是彎曲，torturous 是折磨人的，別搞混。

senses.en: causing great pain or suffering

ex.en: Waiting for the test results was a torturous experience.
ex.zh: 等待檢查結果的過程非常煎熬。

root.note: 像被扭絞般痛苦 → 折磨人的

senses.en: easy to control or influence
(of a problem) easy to deal with

ex.en: The horse became more tractable after months of patient training.
ex.zh: 經過數月的耐心訓練，這匹馬變得溫順多了。

root.note: 能被牽著走的 → 溫順的

senses.en: a distinguishing quality or characteristic

ex.en: Curiosity is a common trait among successful scientists.
ex.zh: 好奇心是成功科學家的共同特質。

root.note: 畫出來的一筆線條 → 特徵

senses.en: the path of an object moving through the air or space
the general direction of development

ex.en: The company's growth trajectory impressed investors.
ex.zh: 這家公司的成長軌跡讓投資人印象深刻。

root.note: 投擲出去橫越天空的路線 → 軌道

senses.en: something that restricts freedom of action (usually plural)
to restrict or hinder

ex.en: Artists should not let tradition trammel their imagination.
ex.zh: 藝術家不該讓傳統束縛他們的想像力。

senses.en: free from disturbance; calm and peaceful

ex.en: We spent a tranquil afternoon by the lake.
ex.zh: 我們在湖邊度過了一個寧靜的下午。

senses.en: a state of peace and calm

ex.en: The monks value the tranquility of their mountain home.
ex.zh: 僧侶們珍惜山中居所的寧靜。

root.note: 平靜的狀態 → 寧靜

senses.en: to make calm, especially by giving a drug

ex.en: The vet had to tranquilize the tiger before examining it.
ex.zh: 獸醫必須先讓老虎鎮定下來才能檢查。

root.note: 使平靜 → 鎮定

senses.en: to carry out or conduct business

ex.en: Customers can transact most bank business online now.
ex.zh: 顧客現在可以在網路上辦理大多數銀行業務。

root.note: 把事情做完、推動到底 → 處理交易

senses.en: on the other side of the Alps, especially as seen from Italy; crossing the Alps
senses.zh: 阿爾卑斯山那一邊的；橫越阿爾卑斯山的

ex.en: The new transalpine rail tunnel cuts hours off the trip from Zurich to Milan.
ex.zh: 新的阿爾卑斯山鐵路隧道讓蘇黎世到米蘭的車程縮短了好幾個小時。

root.note: 越過阿爾卑斯山的

senses.en: crossing the Atlantic Ocean; involving countries on both sides of it
senses.zh: 橫越大西洋的；跨大西洋的

ex.en: Lindbergh made the first solo transatlantic flight in 1927.
ex.zh: 林白在 1927 年完成首次單人飛越大西洋的飛行。

root.note: 越過大西洋的

senses.en: to go beyond the limits of something
to be greater or better than

ex.en: Great music can transcend barriers of language and culture.
ex.zh: 偉大的音樂能超越語言和文化的隔閡。

root.note: 爬過去、越過去 → 超越

senses.en: going beyond ordinary limits; surpassing
existing beyond the physical world
senses.zh: 超驗的；超越物質世界的

ex.en: Critics called her performance a transcendent moment in theater history.
ex.zh: 評論家稱她的演出是戲劇史上超凡的一刻。

root.note: 越過一般界限的 → 超凡的

senses.en: crossing or extending across a continent

ex.en: The first transcontinental railroad in the U.S. was completed in 1869.
ex.zh: 美國第一條橫貫大陸鐵路於 1869 年完工。

root.note: 橫越大陸的

senses.en: to write down spoken words or copy text in written form
to arrange music for a different instrument

ex.en: The assistant will transcribe the interview recording by Friday.
ex.zh: 助理會在週五前把訪談錄音謄成文字稿。

root.note: 把內容轉寫過去 → 謄寫

senses.en: a written or printed copy of spoken words
an official record of a student's grades

ex.en: Colleges will ask for your high school transcript.
ex.zh: 大學會要求你提供高中成績單。

root.note: 轉寫出來的東西 → 文字稿

senses.en: to move from one place, person, or job to another
[ˋtrænsfɚ] the act of moving something or someone

ex.en: She plans to transfer to a university closer to home.
ex.zh: 她打算轉學到離家比較近的大學。

root.note: 帶到另一邊 → 轉移

senses.en: able to be moved or passed to another person, place, or use

ex.en: Communication is a transferable skill that is useful in any job.
ex.zh: 溝通是一項可轉移的技能，在任何工作中都用得上。

root.note: 可以帶到別處的 → 可轉移的

senses.en: a person to whom something is transferred, or who is transferred
senses.zh: 受讓人；被調任者；轉學生

ex.en: The ticket's transferee must show ID at the gate.
ex.zh: 這張票的受讓人入場時必須出示身分證件。

root.note: 接受轉讓的人 → 受讓人

senses.en: the act of moving something from one place or person to another
(psychology) the redirection of feelings onto another person

ex.en: The transference of power to the new government went smoothly.
ex.zh: 政權移交給新政府的過程很順利。

root.note: 帶到另一邊 → 轉移

senses.en: a person who transfers something, especially property

ex.en: The transferrer must sign the form before the shares can change hands.
ex.zh: 股份易手前，轉讓人必須先在表格上簽名。

root.note: 把東西轉過去的人 → 轉讓人

senses.en: to change the appearance of, making it more beautiful or spiritual
senses.zh: 使改觀；使變得光彩美好

ex.en: A single smile seemed to transfigure her tired face.
ex.zh: 一抹微笑彷彿讓她疲憊的臉龐煥然一新。

root.note: 改變形狀 → 使改觀

senses.en: to transfer blood or fluid into a person's body
to cause to pass through; to permeate

ex.en: Doctors had to transfuse two units of blood during surgery.
ex.zh: 醫生在手術中必須輸兩單位的血。

root.note: 倒過去 → 輸血

senses.en: able to be transfused

ex.en: Only blood that passes safety screening is considered transfusible.
ex.zh: 只有通過安全篩檢的血液才被視為可輸用。

root.note: 可以倒過去的 → 可輸入的

senses.en: the transfer of blood from one person into another
an injection of something new, such as money or energy

ex.en: The accident victim needed a blood transfusion right away.
ex.zh: 那名車禍傷者需要立即輸血。

root.note: 倒過去 → 輸血

senses.en: to break a law, rule, or moral principle
to go beyond a limit

ex.en: Players who transgress the rules will be sent off the field.
ex.zh: 違反規則的球員將被罰出場。

root.note: 走過界線 → 違反

senses.en: the state of lasting only a short time

ex.en: Cherry blossoms remind us of the transience of beauty.
ex.zh: 櫻花提醒我們美好事物的短暫。

root.note: 一下就走過去了 → 短暫

senses.en: lasting only for a short time
a person who stays in a place only briefly

ex.en: Fame on social media is often transient.
ex.zh: 社群媒體上的名氣往往轉瞬即逝。

root.note: 一下就走過去的 → 短暫的

senses.en: the process of changing from one state or condition to another
to undergo or cause a change

ex.en: The transition from high school to college can be challenging.
ex.zh: 從高中過渡到大學可能充滿挑戰。

root.note: 從一邊走到另一邊 → 過渡

senses.en: not permanent; lasting only briefly

ex.en: The economic slowdown proved to be transitory.
ex.zh: 這波經濟放緩後來證明只是暫時的。

root.note: 只是走過去的 → 短暫的

senses.en: to express words in another language
to change or be converted into another form

ex.en: Hard work does not always translate into success.
ex.zh: 努力不一定總能轉化為成功。

root.note: 把意思帶到另一種語言 → 翻譯

senses.en: a person who translates written text from one language to another

ex.en: The novel's translator spent two years on the English edition.
ex.zh: 這本小說的譯者花了兩年完成英文版。

root.note: 把意思帶過去的人 → 譯者

senses.en: the quality of allowing light to pass through partially

ex.en: Collectors prize the translucence of fine porcelain.
ex.zh: 收藏家很看重精緻瓷器的半透明質感。

root.note: 光能穿透 → 半透明

senses.en: allowing light to pass through but not completely clear

ex.en: The bathroom window is made of translucent glass for privacy.
ex.zh: 浴室窗戶用半透明玻璃來保護隱私。

root.note: 光能穿透的 → 半透明的

mn: transparent 是完全透明，translucent 是透光但看不清。

senses.en: able to be passed from one person or organism to another

ex.en: The new variant appears to be more transmissible than earlier strains.
ex.zh: 新變種似乎比先前的病毒株更容易傳播。

root.note: 能被送過去的 → 可傳播的

senses.en: the act of passing something from one person or place to another
a broadcast; the sending of signals
the part of a vehicle that sends power from the engine to the wheels

ex.en: Washing hands reduces the transmission of germs.
ex.zh: 洗手可以減少細菌的傳播。

root.note: 送過去 → 傳送

senses.en: to send or pass from one person, place, or thing to another
to broadcast a signal

ex.en: Mosquitoes can transmit diseases such as malaria.
ex.zh: 蚊子會傳播瘧疾等疾病。

root.note: 送過去 → 傳送

senses.en: to change completely into a different form or substance

ex.en: Alchemists hoped to transmute lead into gold.
ex.zh: 煉金術士希望把鉛變成黃金。

root.note: 徹底改變 → 轉化

senses.en: allowing light through so objects behind can be clearly seen
open and honest; easy to understand
senses.zh: 公開透明的；顯而易見的

ex.en: Voters want a government that is transparent about how it spends money.
ex.zh: 選民希望政府公開透明地說明如何花錢。

root.note: 東西能穿透顯現出來 → 透明的

senses.en: to happen; to become known
(of plants) to give off water vapor through leaves

ex.en: Nobody knows exactly what will transpire at tomorrow's meeting.
ex.zh: 沒有人確切知道明天的會議會發生什麼事。

root.note: 透過（葉面）呼氣 → 蒸散；消息透出來 → 被得知、發生

senses.en: to move a plant, organ, or person to another place
[ˋtrænsˏplænt] an operation to move an organ from one body to another

ex.en: Gardeners transplant tomato seedlings once the frost is over.
ex.zh: 霜期一過，園丁就移植番茄幼苗。

root.note: 種到別處 → 移植

senses.en: the act of switching the order or position of things
the act of writing or playing music in a different key

ex.en: A simple transposition of two digits caused the error in the bill.
ex.zh: 兩個數字的前後顛倒造成了帳單的錯誤。

root.note: 放到另一邊 → 調換位置

senses.en: placed or extending across something

ex.en: The surgeon made a small transverse cut across the abdomen.
ex.zh: 外科醫生在腹部橫向切了一個小切口。

root.note: 轉向橫著放 → 橫向的

senses.en: painful or exhausting effort; hardship (often plural)
(old use) the pain of childbirth

ex.en: The memoir describes the travail of immigrants building a new life.
ex.zh: 這本回憶錄描述了移民重建新生活的艱辛。

mn: travel（旅行）就是從 travail 演變而來：古時旅行是件苦差事。

senses.en: a false, absurd, or distorted version of something

ex.en: The unfair trial was a travesty of justice.
ex.zh: 這場不公的審判是對正義的嘲弄。

root.note: 換上別的衣服、變了樣 → 歪曲、拙劣模仿

mn: 常見片語 a travesty of justice（對正義的嘲弄）。

senses.en: guilty of betraying trust
having hidden dangers

ex.en: Icy roads made the mountain drive treacherous.
ex.zh: 結冰的路面讓山路駕駛變得危機四伏。

senses.en: betrayal of trust

ex.en: The general's treachery led to the fall of the city.
ex.zh: 將軍的背叛導致這座城市淪陷。

senses.en: involving the crime of betraying one's country

ex.en: Selling military secrets to a foreign power is a treasonable offense.
ex.zh: 把軍事機密賣給外國是叛國罪。

root.note: 構成叛國的

senses.en: a formal written work that deals with a subject systematically

ex.en: Newton's treatise on motion changed the course of physics.
ex.zh: 牛頓關於運動的論著改變了物理學的發展。

senses.en: three times as much or as many
to become or make three times as large
a high-pitched voice or sound; the highest part in music

ex.en: The price of the concert tickets could treble on resale sites.
ex.zh: 演唱會門票在轉售網站上可能漲到三倍。

senses.en: three times as much; triply

ex.en: After the accident, she was trebly careful on the stairs.
ex.zh: 那次意外後，她上下樓梯時格外加倍小心。

root.note: 三倍地

senses.en: very great in amount, size, or power
extremely good

ex.en: The volunteers made a tremendous effort to clean up the beach.
ex.zh: 志工們花了極大的力氣清理海灘。

root.note: 大到令人發抖的 → 巨大的

senses.en: a slight earthquake
an involuntary shaking movement

ex.en: A small tremor shook the windows early this morning.
ex.zh: 今天清晨一次小地震把窗戶震得嘎嘎響。

root.note: 顫動 → 輕微地震

senses.en: shaking or trembling slightly, often from nervousness

ex.en: She answered in a tremulous voice, clearly afraid.
ex.zh: 她用顫抖的聲音回答，顯然很害怕。

root.note: 一直在顫抖的

senses.en: sharp, clear, and forceful in expression

ex.en: The critic's trenchant review exposed every flaw in the plot.
ex.zh: 評論家尖銳的評論揭露了情節的每一個漏洞。

root.note: 像刀一樣切得深 → 尖銳的

senses.en: a feeling of fear or worry about something that may happen

ex.en: She opened the college letter with some trepidation.
ex.zh: 她有些忐忑地打開大學寄來的信。

root.note: 因害怕而發抖 → 惶恐

mn: intrepid（無畏的）是 in-（不）+ trepid（害怕）。

senses.en: a frame with a horizontal beam and legs, used to support a table
a framework supporting a bridge

ex.en: The old train crossed the valley on a wooden trestle.
ex.zh: 老火車沿著木造棧橋穿越山谷。

senses.en: a group or set of three related things or people
a musical chord of three notes

ex.en: The triad of poor diet, stress, and little sleep harms health.
ex.zh: 飲食不良、壓力與睡眠不足這三者會損害健康。

root.note: 三個一組

senses.en: an official in ancient Rome chosen to protect the rights of common people
a champion of the people; a raised platform for speakers

ex.en: The Roman tribune could veto laws that harmed ordinary citizens.
ex.zh: 羅馬護民官可以否決有損平民的法律。

root.note: 代表部族的官員 → 護民官

mn: 很多報紙取名 Tribune，意思是「人民的喉舌」。

senses.en: the use of tricks to deceive or cheat

ex.en: The scammers used trickery to get people's bank details.
ex.zh: 詐騙集團用詭計騙取人們的銀行資料。

senses.en: a flag with three bands of different colors, especially the French flag
having three colors

ex.en: The French tricolor flew above the town hall.
ex.zh: 法國三色旗在市政廳上空飄揚。

root.note: 三種顏色 → 三色旗

senses.en: a vehicle like a bicycle but with three wheels

ex.en: My little brother rode his tricycle around the park.
ex.zh: 我弟弟騎著他的三輪車繞公園。

root.note: 三個輪子 → 三輪車

senses.en: a spear with three points

ex.en: The statue shows Poseidon holding a trident above the waves.
ex.zh: 這尊雕像呈現波塞頓在浪濤上高舉三叉戟。

root.note: 有三個齒 → 三叉戟

senses.en: happening every three years; lasting three years
senses.zh: 每三年一次的；持續三年的

senses.en: an event held every three years
senses.zh: 三年展；三年一度的活動

ex.en: The city hosts a triennial art festival that draws visitors worldwide.
ex.zh: 這座城市每三年舉辦一次藝術節，吸引世界各地的遊客。

root.note: 每三年的

senses.en: the quality of being neat, tidy, and in good order; slimness

ex.en: Visitors admired the trimness of the small garden.
ex.zh: 訪客讚賞這座小花園的整潔。

root.note: 整齊的狀態

senses.en: a group of three closely related things
(the Trinity) in Christianity, the union of Father, Son, and Holy Spirit

ex.en: Speed, strength, and skill formed the trinity of her success.
ex.zh: 速度、力量與技巧是她成功的三大支柱。

root.note: 三者合一

senses.en: a group of three people or things
a piece of music for three performers

ex.en: The trio of friends traveled across Europe by train.
ex.zh: 這三個好朋友搭火車遊遍歐洲。

root.note: 三個一組

senses.en: consisting of three parts; three times as much
to increase to three times as much

ex.en: The number of online shoppers could triple in five years.
ex.zh: 網購人數五年內可能增加到三倍。

root.note: 三倍

senses.en: one of three identical copies (often in triplicate)
existing in three copies
[ˋtrɪpləˏket] to make three copies of

ex.en: The form must be filled out in triplicate.
ex.zh: 這份表格必須填寫一式三份。

root.note: 摺成三份 → 一式三份

senses.en: the state of being threefold; a group of three
(astrology) a set of three zodiac signs of the same element

ex.en: The poem explores the triplicity of mind, body, and spirit.
ex.zh: 這首詩探討心智、身體與靈魂的三重性。

root.note: 三重的性質

senses.en: a three-legged stand used to support a camera or other device

ex.en: Use a tripod to keep the camera steady in low light.
ex.zh: 光線不足時，用三腳架讓相機保持穩定。

root.note: 三隻腳 → 三腳架

senses.en: to divide into three equal parts

ex.en: Ancient mathematicians tried to trisect an angle using only a compass and ruler.
ex.zh: 古代數學家試圖只用圓規和直尺三等分一個角。

root.note: 切成三份 → 三等分

senses.en: overused and therefore dull or unoriginal

ex.en: The movie's ending felt trite and predictable.
ex.zh: 這部電影的結局感覺老套又可預測。

parts.m: rubbed, worn 磨損（拉丁文 terere）

root.note: 被磨舊了的 → 陳腐的

senses.en: one of three people who share power, especially in ancient Rome
senses.zh: （古羅馬）三執政之一；三巨頭之一

ex.en: Julius Caesar ruled as a triumvir alongside Pompey and Crassus.
ex.zh: 凱撒與龐培、克拉蘇共同組成三頭政治，是三巨頭之一。

root.note: 三個男人之一 → 三執政之一

mn: 三人共治的政權稱為 triumvirate。

senses.en: of little value or importance

ex.en: Don't waste the meeting arguing about trivial details.
ex.zh: 別把會議時間浪費在爭論瑣碎的細節上。

root.note: 三岔路口的閒聊 → 瑣碎的

senses.en: causing difficulty or annoyance

ex.en: The troublesome printer jammed three times this morning.
ex.zh: 那台麻煩的印表機今天早上卡紙了三次。

root.note: 帶來麻煩的

senses.en: an eager or quick tendency to argue or fight

ex.en: His truculence made every negotiation longer and more tense.
ex.zh: 他好鬥的態度讓每次談判都拖得更久、更緊繃。

root.note: 兇猛的性情 → 好鬥
